Introduction:
Welcome to the Department of Livestock Production & Continuing Education, committed to advancing the field of animal sciences and promoting continuous learning in the realm of livestock management. Established with a vision to drive innovation, sustainability, and excellence in the livestock industry, our department is poised to make significant contributions to the development of agriculture and the welfare of livestock.
Core Values:
Excellence:
We pursue excellence in research, education, and outreach to continuously improve animal production practices.
Integrity:
We uphold the highest ethical standards in all our endeavors, fostering trust and accountability.
Innovation:
We embrace innovation to address evolving challenges and opportunities in animal agriculture.
Collaboration:
We foster a culture of collaboration, valuing diverse perspectives and partnerships within and beyond our department.
Sustainability:
We are committed to promoting environmentally sustainable and socially responsible animal production practices.
Mission:
Our mission is to be a catalyst for transformative change in livestock production through cutting-edge research, comprehensive education, and community engagement. We strive to empower students of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa in particular and of Pakistan in general in the animal science domain with the knowledge and skills necessary to meet the evolving challenges of the livestock sector while promoting ethical practices and environmental stewardship.
Vision:
The Department of Livestock Production & Continuing Education envisions a future where the livestock industry thrives in harmony with nature, producing high-quality and sustainable animal products in Pakistan. We aim to be a leader in fostering scientific advancements, disseminating knowledge, and fostering a community that values the welfare of animals, economic viability, and ecological balance.
Sub-Disciplines Focus:
“In collaboration with our specialized 4 major disciplines:
Animal Breeding and Genetics:
The Animal Breeding and Genetics sub- discipline is at the forefront of developing breeding strategies to improve the genetic traits of livestock. Through rigorous research and education, we aim to enhance the overall quality and performance of livestock, contributing to the sustainability and profitability of the industry.
Animal Nutrition:
In the Animal Nutrition sub-discipline, we focus on optimizing the diets of livestock for enhanced health, productivity, and environmental sustainability. Our research and education programs cover a broad spectrum, from formulating balanced feed to exploring innovative approaches in nutritional science.
Poultry Science:
Poultry Science is dedicated to advancing the science and practice of poultry farming. Our efforts encompass genetics, nutrition, disease management, and welfare, aiming to support the poultry industry in meeting the growing demand for high-quality and ethically produced poultry products.
Livestock Management:
Livestock Management is the cornerstone of our department, addressing the holistic aspects of animal husbandry. Our focus includes herd health, reproduction, farm management, and sustainable practices. By providing comprehensive training, we empower individuals to manage livestock enterprises efficiently and ethically.

Chairperson Message

It is with great pleasure and excitement that I address you today as the newly appointed Chairman of the Department of Livestock Production & Continuing Education. As we stand on the threshold of a new chapter, I am filled with optimism and enthusiasm for the incredible journey that lies ahead.
Our department, with its overarching goal of advancing livestock production and fostering continuous education, plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of the agricultural landscape. I am honored to lead a team of dedicated professionals and to collaborate with each of you in our collective pursuit of excellence.
Within the framework of our department, we have identified four key pillars that will guide our efforts: Animal Breeding and Genetics, Animal Nutrition, Poultry Science and Livestock Management. Each of these sub-disciplines represents a crucial facet of our mission, and together, they form a comprehensive approach to addressing the challenges and opportunities in the field.
As we embark on this journey together, let us be inspired by a shared vision of excellence, innovation, and continuous learning. Our success will not only be measured in terms of academic achievements but also in the positive impact we make on the lives of farmers, the community, and the broader agricultural industry. Likewise, the Department of Livestock Production & Continuing Education invites collaboration, curiosity, and dedication from students, researchers, and industry partners alike. Together, we can build a future where livestock production is not just a livelihood, but a harmonious coexistence with nature and a source of sustainable nourishment for generations to come.
I am confident that with our team comprised of unparalleled expertise, dedication, and passion, the Department of Livestock Production & Continuing Education will become a beacon of knowledge and a catalyst for positive change in the realm of livestock sector.
Let us unite, explore new horizons, and strive for greatness as we contribute to the advancement of livestock production and education.
Dr. Tahir Usman
Associate Professor
HOD, Department of Livestock Production
